title: Hozirgi zamon: odatlar va kundalik ishlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida Present Simple yordamida o‘z odatlaringiz va kun tartibingiz haqida gapirasiz, inkor va savol gaplar tuzasiz, always, usually, often, sometimes, never so‘zlarini to‘g‘ri o‘ringa qo‘yib, sakkizta gapdan iborat hikoya aytasiz.

scenes.title: Odatlar va kundalik ishlar
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Sakkizinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda soatni aytishni va kun tartibini o‘rgandik: “It’s seven o’clock”, “at half past eight”. Bugun shu soatlarga fe’llarni qo‘shamiz. Har kuni nima qilishingizni, qanchalik tez-tez qilishingizni aytasiz. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida sakkizta gapdan iborat odatlaringiz haqida hikoya qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about habits and daily routines. What do you do every day?
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun odatlar va kundalik ishlar haqida gaplashamiz. Siz har kuni nima qilasiz?

scenes.title: Present Simple nima uchun kerak
board: Present Simple = odatlar, rejimlar, doimiy faktlar
I work in a bank. (doim shunday)

examples.t: I get up at seven every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni soat yettida turaman.

scenes.say_native: Present Simple, ya’ni oddiy hozirgi zamon, bugungi paytda bo‘layotgan ishni emas, odatiy va takrorlanadigan ishni bildiradi. Har kungi tartib, ish joyi, doimiy faktlar shu zamonda aytiladi. O‘zbekchada “men soat yettida turaman” deymiz, bu ham xuddi shunday odat. Ingliz tilida bunda fe’lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi. Hozir sodir bo‘layotgan ish haqida keyingi darslarda gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: I get up at seven every day. Water boils at one hundred degrees.
scenes.say_uz: Men har kuni yettida turaman. Suv yuz darajada qaynaydi.

scenes.title: I, you, we, they: fe’l o‘zgarmaydi
board: I work · you work · we work · they work
scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoida juda oson. “I”, “you”, “we”, “they” bilan fe’l hech qanday qo‘shimchasiz, lug‘atdagi shaklida keladi: I work, you work, we work, they work. O‘zbekchada fe’lga shaxs qo‘shimchasi qo‘shiladi: ishlayman, ishlaysiz, ishlaymiz, ishlashadi. Inglizchada esa shaxsni ko‘rsatadigan so‘z fe’ldan oldin turadi, fe’lning o‘zi o‘zgarmaydi. Shuning uchun olmoshni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: I work. You work. We work. They work.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlayman. Siz ishlaysiz. Biz ishlaymiz. Ular ishlashadi.

scenes.title: Kundalik fe’llar
board: get up · have breakfast · go to work
start work · finish work · go home
scenes.say_native: Mana kun tartibining asosiy fe’llari. Get up — uyqudan turish. Have breakfast — nonushta qilish. Go to work — ishga borish. Start work va finish work — ishni boshlash va tugatish. Go home — uyga qaytish. Watch TV — televizor ko‘rish. Go to bed — uxlashga yotish. Nonushta uchun odatda “have breakfast” deyiladi. Bu iborani shundayligicha yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Get up. Have breakfast. Go to work. Finish work. Go home. Go to bed.
scenes.say_uz: Turish. Nonushta qilish. Ishga borish. Ishni tugatish. Uyga qaytish. Uxlashga yotish.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha am, is, are qo‘shmang
scenes.say_native: Bu darsda eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolardan biri: fe’l oldiga “am”, “is” yoki “are” qo‘yish. Kimdir “I am go to work” deydi. Aslida “am” va “are” tavsif uchun, masalan “I am a teacher”. Harakat haqida gapirsangiz, faqat fe’lning o‘zi kerak: “I go to work”. Bir gapda ikkita fe’l bo‘lmasin: yoki “I am” va ot, yoki faqat “I go”. Buni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: I go to work. They study English. Not: I am go to work.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga boraman. Ular ingliz tilini o‘rganishadi. I am go to work emas.

scenes.title: Gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekranda uchta qisqa ma’lumot bor. Har birini to‘liq gapga aylantiring. Olmoshni aytishni unutmang va fe’lga qo‘shimcha qo‘shmang. Birinchi: I, get up, at six. Ikkinchi: we, have lunch, at one. Uchinchi: they, go home, at five. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I, get up, at six. We, have lunch, at one. They, go home, at five.
scenes.say_uz: Men, turish, oltida. Biz, tushlik qilish, birda. Ular, uyga ketish, beshda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “I get up at six”. Ikkinchi, “We have lunch at one”. Uchinchi, “They go home at five”. Ko‘rdingizmi, fe’llar o‘zgarmadi, soat oldidan “at” keldi. Agar “I am get up” yoki “we haves lunch” degan bo‘lsangiz, avvalgi ikki qoidani yana bir bor eslang. Endi esa asosiy yangilikka o‘tamiz: uchinchi shaxs, ya’ni “he”, “she” va “it”.
scenes.say: I get up at six. We have lunch at one. They go home at five.
scenes.say_uz: Men oltida turaman. Biz birda tushlik qilamiz. Ular beshda uyga ketishadi.

scenes.title: He, she, it: fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi
board: He works. She lives. It rains.
scenes.say_native: Endi eng muhim qoida. “He”, “she” va “it” bilan, ya’ni bir kishi yoki bir narsa haqida gapirganda, fe’lga “s” qo‘shiladi: he works, she lives, it rains. Faqat shu uchta olmosh! “Ali” yoki “my mother” ham “he” va “she” ning o‘rnini bosadi, shuning uchun “Ali works”, “my mother lives”. O‘zbek tilida bunday qoida yo‘q, shuning uchun “s” ni ko‘pchilik unutadi. Mashq bilan o‘rganib ketasiz.
scenes.say: He works in a bank. She lives in Samarkand. It rains a lot here.
scenes.say_uz: U bankda ishlaydi. U Samarqandda yashaydi. Bu yerda ko‘p yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

scenes.title: Imlo: -s, -es, -ies
scenes.say_native: Imlo qoidalari. Ko‘p fe’llarga oddiy “s” qo‘shiladi: works, plays. Agar fe’l “ch”, “sh”, “s”, “x” yoki “o” bilan tugasa, “es” qo‘shamiz: watch — watches, wash — washes, go — goes, do — does. Agar fe’l undosh va “y” bilan tugasa, “y” o‘rniga “ies” yoziladi: study — studies. “Play” da “y” dan oldin unli bor, shuning uchun plays. Bitta shakl butunlay boshqacha: have — has.
scenes.say: Works. Plays. Watches. Goes. Studies. Has.
scenes.say_uz: Ishlaydi. O‘ynaydi. Ko‘radi. Boradi. O‘qiydi. Bor.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: -s uch xil o‘qiladi
scenes.say_native: Oxiridagi “s” uch xil eshitiladi. “Works” kabi jarangsiz tovushdan keyin “s” kabi o‘qiladi. “Lives”, “plays”, “goes” kabi jarangli tovush yoki unlidan keyin “z” eshitiladi. “Watches”, “washes”, “finishes” kabi so‘zlarda esa alohida bo‘g‘in qo‘shiladi: “watchiz”. Bu o‘zbek tilida ham bor tovushlar, faqat qoidasi boshqa. Eshitib, takrorlab, odatlanib oling.
scenes.say: Works. Lives. Watches. He works. She lives. He watches TV.
scenes.say_uz: Ishlaydi. Yashaydi. Ko‘radi. U ishlaydi. U yashaydi. U televizor ko‘radi.

scenes.title: U uchun -s ni unutish
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: “He work in a bank”. O‘zbekcha gapda bu muammo emas, shuning uchun “s” ni tushirib qoldirish tabiiy. Lekin ingliz tilida “he”, “she”, “it” dan keyin “s” shart. Ikkinchi xato: “she have a car” yoki hatto “she haves”. To‘g‘risi: “she has a car”. “Has” alohida so‘z, “haves” degan so‘z umuman yo‘q. Gapingizni aytishdan oldin kim haqida gapirayotganingizni bir o‘ylab oling.
scenes.say: He works in a bank. She has a car. Not: he work, she have.
scenes.say_uz: U bankda ishlaydi. Uning mashinasi bor. He work, she have emas.

scenes.title: Fe’lga -s qo‘shing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklda ayting. Birinchi: my father work in a school. Ikkinchi: she watch TV at night. Uchinchi: Anna study English. To‘rtinchi: he have a big family. Har birini to‘liq gap qilib, baland ovozda ayting. Imlo va talaffuzni eslang.
scenes.say: My father, work, in a school. She, watch, TV at night. Anna, study, English. He, have, a big family.
scenes.say_uz: Otam, ishlaydi, maktabda. U, ko‘radi, kechqurun televizor. Anna, o‘qiydi, ingliz tilini. Uning, bor, katta oilasi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: my father works in a school. She watches TV at night. Anna studies English. He has a big family. Agar ikkinchi javobda “watchs” desangiz, bu odatiy xato, “ch” dan keyin “es” qo‘shiladi. Uchinchisida “studys” emas, “studies”. Va oxirgisida “haves” emas, “has”. Hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, barakalla, uchinchi shaxs qoidasi sizga yaxshi ma’lum.
scenes.say: My father works in a school. She watches TV at night. Anna studies English. He has a big family.
scenes.say_uz: Otam maktabda ishlaydi. U kechqurun televizor ko‘radi. Anna ingliz tilini o‘qiydi. Uning katta oilasi bor.

scenes.title: Inkor: don’t va doesn’t
board: I / you / we / they + don't + verb
scenes.say_native: Inkor gap yasash uchun yordamchi so‘z ishlatamiz. “I”, “you”, “we”, “they” bilan “don’t”, ya’ni “do not”. “He”, “she”, “it” bilan “doesn’t”, ya’ni “does not”. Ulardan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda keladi. O‘zbekchada inkor fe’lning ichida: ichmayman, ishlamaydi. Inglizchada esa inkor alohida so‘z bo‘lib, fe’ldan oldin turadi: I don’t drink, she doesn’t work.
scenes.say: I don't drink coffee. She doesn't work on Sundays.
scenes.say_uz: Men kofe ichmayman. U yakshanba kunlari ishlamaydi.

scenes.title: Doesn’t dan keyin -s yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ikkita xato kutib turadi. Birinchisi: “She doesn’t works”. Yodda tuting: uchinchi shaxs belgisi, ya’ni “s”, bir marta aytiladi, va uni “doesn’t” o‘zi ko‘tarib turibdi. Shuning uchun fe’l oddiy shaklda qoladi: “she doesn’t work”. Ikkinchisi: “he don’t like tea”. “He”, “she”, “it” bilan faqat “doesn’t” ishlatiladi. Bu xatolarni gapirayotganda diqqat bilan oldini oling.
scenes.say: She doesn't work. He doesn't like tea. Not: she doesn't works.
scenes.say_uz: U ishlamaydi. U choyni yoqtirmaydi. She doesn't works emas.

scenes.title: Inkor gap qiling
board: 3) We watch TV in the morning. → ?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta darak gapni inkor gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: I drink coffee. Ikkinchi: he works on Sundays. Uchinchi: we watch TV in the morning. Esda tuting: “I” va “we” bilan “don’t”, “he” bilan “doesn’t”, va uchinchi shaxs “s” si yo‘qoladi. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I drink coffee. He works on Sundays. We watch TV in the morning.
scenes.say_uz: Men kofe ichaman. U yakshanba kunlari ishlaydi. Biz ertalab televizor ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) We don't watch TV in the morning.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: I don’t drink coffee. He doesn’t work on Sundays. We don’t watch TV in the morning. Ikkinchi gapga qarang: “works” bo‘lgan, endi “work” bo‘ldi, chunki “s” ni “doesn’t” oldi. Uchinchi gapda “don’t” ishlatildi, chunki “we”. Mana shu, to‘g‘ri yordamchi so‘zni tanlash, inkorning butun qoidasi. Endi savol gap qanday tuzilishini ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I don't drink coffee. He doesn't work on Sundays. We don't watch TV in the morning.
scenes.say_uz: Men kofe ichmayman. U yakshanba kunlari ishlamaydi. Biz ertalab televizor ko‘rmaymiz.

scenes.title: Savol: Do va Does
board: Do + I / you / we / they + verb?
Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
scenes.say_native: Savol gap uchun yordamchi so‘z gapning boshiga chiqadi. “I”, “you”, “we”, “they” bilan “Do”: Do you work here? “He”, “she”, “it” bilan “Does”: Does she live in Tashkent? O‘zbekchada savolni “-mi” yuklamasi bilan yasaymiz: ishlaysizmi? Inglizchada bu rolni gap boshidagi “do” yoki “does” bajaradi. Qisqa javob ham shu so‘z bilan: “Yes, I do”, “No, she doesn’t”.
scenes.say: Do you work here? Yes, I do. Does she live in Tashkent? No, she doesn't.
scenes.say_uz: Siz shu yerda ishlaysizmi? Ha. U Toshkentda yashaydimi? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savolda ham -s qo‘shmang
scenes.say_native: Inkordagi qoida savolda ham ishlaydi. “Does she works here?” noto‘g‘ri, “s” ni “does” ko‘tarib turibdi: “Does she work here?”. Ikkinchi xato: faqat ohang bilan savol berish, “You work here?”. Do‘stlar orasida eshitiladi, lekin o‘rganishda to‘liq shaklni ishlating: “Do you work here?”. Qisqa javob ham “do” yoki “does” bilan: “Yes, she does”.
scenes.say: Does she work here? Yes, she does. Do you work here? No, I don't.
scenes.say_uz: U shu yerda ishlaydimi? Ha. Siz shu yerda ishlaysizmi? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savol bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: “you, live in Tashkent” so‘zlaridan savol tuzing. Ikkinchi: “he, play football” so‘zlaridan savol tuzing. Uchinchi: “Does she speak English?” degan savolga “ha” deb qisqa javob bering. Esda tuting: gap boshida “do” yoki “does”, keyin olmosh va oddiy fe’l.
scenes.say: Make a question: you, live in Tashkent. He, play football. Answer: Does she speak English? Yes.
scenes.say_uz: Savol tuzing: siz, Toshkentda yashash. U, futbol o‘ynash. Javob bering: U inglizcha gapiradimi? Ha.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Do you live in Tashkent? Does he play football? Va uchinchisiga qisqa javob: Yes, she does. “Do” ni “he” bilan ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz, “does” ga almashtiring. Qisqa javobda “Yes, she speaks” demang, “Yes, she does” deng. Bu tuzilmani yaxshi yodlab oling, chunki ingliz tilidagi suhbatlarning katta qismi shu savol-javoblardan iborat.
scenes.say: Do you live in Tashkent? Does he play football? Yes, she does.
scenes.say_uz: Siz Toshkentda yashaysizmi? U futbol o‘ynaydimi? Ha, o‘ynaydi.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: Dilshodning kuni
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Anna va Dilshod hamkasb. Anna Dilshodning kuni haqida so‘raydi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, to‘rtta savolga javob berasiz: Dilshod qayerda ishlaydi? Nonushtada nima ichadi? Uning rafiqasi qayerda ishlaydi? Dilshod nimani hech qachon qilmaydi? Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Do you work in an office, Dilshod? No, I work at home. Do you have breakfast? Yes, I have tea and bread. Does your wife work at home too? No, she works at a school. Who cooks dinner? She does. I never wash the dishes!
scenes.say_uz: Siz ofisda ishlaysizmi, Dilshod? Yo‘q, men uyda ishlayman. Nonushta qilasizmi? Ha, choy va non. Rafiqangiz ham uyda ishlaydimi? Yo‘q, u maktabda ishlaydi. Kechki ovqatni kim pishiradi? U. Men hech qachon idish yuvmayman!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) What does he have for breakfast?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: Dilshod qayerda ishlaydi? Ikkinchi: u nonushtada nima ichadi va yeydi? Uchinchi: uning rafiqasi qayerda ishlaydi? To‘rtinchi: Dilshod nimani hech qachon qilmaydi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, “s” ni unutmasdan ayting.
scenes.say: Where does Dilshod work? What does he have for breakfast? Where does his wife work? What does he never do?
scenes.say_uz: Dilshod qayerda ishlaydi? Nonushtada nima yeydi? Rafiqasi qayerda ishlaydi? U nimani hech qachon qilmaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Dilshod uyda ishlaydi. Nonushtada choy va non oladi. Rafiqasi maktabda ishlaydi. Dilshod hech qachon idish yuvmaydi, ya’ni “he never washes the dishes”. Diqqat qiling: javobda “he” bilan “works” va “washes” bo‘ldi, chunki gap bir kishi haqida. Dialogdagi “I never wash the dishes” gapi esa “I” bilan, shuning uchun “wash”.
scenes.say: He works at home. Tea and bread. She works at a school. He never washes the dishes.
scenes.say_uz: U uyda ishlaydi. Choy va non. U maktabda ishlaydi. U hech qachon idish yuvmaydi.

scenes.title: Qanchalik tez-tez: so‘zlar shkalasi

examples.t: I always drink tea in the morning.

scenes.say_native: Endi odat qanchalik tez-tez takrorlanishini aytamiz. Bu so‘zlarni shkala deb tasavvur qiling. “Always” — doim, har safar. “Usually” — odatda. “Often” — tez-tez. “Sometimes” — ba’zan. “Never” — hech qachon. Foizlar taxminiy, lekin tartibni his qilishga yordam beradi. Bu so‘zlar “chastota ravishlari” deyiladi. O‘zbekchada ularning o‘rni erkin, inglizchada esa aniq joyi bor.
scenes.say: Always. Usually. Often. Sometimes. Never.
scenes.say_uz: Doim. Odatda. Tez-tez. Ba’zan. Hech qachon.

scenes.title: Chastota so‘zining o‘rni: fe’ldan oldin
board: I usually get up at seven.
She often goes to the gym.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi o‘rin qoidasi: chastota so‘zi egadan keyin, asosiy fe’ldan oldin turadi. I usually get up at seven. She often goes to the gym. They sometimes eat out. Tartibni eslab qoling: ega, chastota so‘zi, fe’l. Ba’zi hollarda bu so‘zlar gap boshida ham keladi, lekin eng ishonchli joy aynan fe’ldan oldin.
scenes.say: I usually get up at seven. She often goes to the gym. They sometimes eat out.
scenes.say_uz: Men odatda yettida turaman. U tez-tez sport zaliga boradi. Ular ba’zan tashqarida ovqatlanishadi.

scenes.title: Be fe’lidan keyin
scenes.say_native: Istisno: “be” fe’li bilan, ya’ni am, is, are bilan, chastota so‘zi fe’ldan keyin keladi. She is always late. I am never tired. He is usually at home. We are often busy. Mana qoida: oddiy fe’ldan oldin, “be” dan keyin. Buning sababi shuki, “be” bu yerda asosiy fe’l, uning ortidan kelgan so‘z holatni bildiradi. Bu istisnoni ham eslab qoling, imtihonlarda ko‘p so‘raladi.
scenes.say: She is always late. I am never tired. He is usually at home.
scenes.say_uz: U doim kechikadi. Men hech qachon charchamayman. U odatda uyda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: I go always — xato
board: ✗ I go always to work by bus.
✓ I always go to work by bus.
scenes.say_native: Mana o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan xato. O‘zbekchada “men ishga doim avtobusda boraman” deyish mumkin, so‘z tartibi erkin. Inglizchada esa “I go always to work” noto‘g‘ri, chunki chastota so‘zi fe’ldan oldin turishi kerak: “I always go to work by bus”. Teskari xato ham bor: “She always is late”. “Be” bilan “always” keyin keladi: “She is always late”. Ikki qoidani birga eslang.
scenes.say: I always go to work by bus. She is always late.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga doim avtobusda boraman. U doim kechikadi.

scenes.title: Chastota so‘zini joyiga qo‘ying
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi so‘zni gapga to‘g‘ri joyga qo‘ying. Birinchi: I get up early, usually. Ikkinchi: she is at home, always. Uchinchi: we watch TV, sometimes. To‘rtinchi: he drinks coffee, never. Esda tuting: oddiy fe’ldan oldin, “is” dan keyin. To‘liq gaplarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I get up early, usually. She is at home, always. We watch TV, sometimes. He drinks coffee, never.
scenes.say_uz: Men erta turaman, odatda. U uyda, doim. Biz televizor ko‘ramiz, ba’zan. U kofe ichadi, hech qachon.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: I usually get up early. She is always at home, bu yerda “is” dan keyin. We sometimes watch TV. He never drinks coffee. To‘rtinchi gapda “drinks” dagi “s” yo‘qolgani yo‘q, “never” inkor ma’nosini bergani bilan “s” kerak. Chunki fe’lning o‘zi hali uchinchi shaxsda turibdi. Agar hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ajoyib, endi “never” ning yana bir muhim xususiyatini ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I usually get up early. She is always at home. We sometimes watch TV. He never drinks coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Men odatda erta turaman. U doim uyda. Biz ba’zan televizor ko‘ramiz. U hech qachon kofe ichmaydi.

scenes.title: Never allaqachon inkor

examples.t: I never watch TV in the morning.
examples.uz: Men ertalab hech qachon televizor ko‘rmayman.

scenes.say_native: “Never” so‘zining o‘zi inkor ma’nosini beradi, uni “don’t” bilan qo‘shmang. O‘zbek tilida ikki inkor tabiiy: “hech qachon kofe ichmayman”, bu yerda “hech qachon” ham, “-ma” ham inkor. Inglizchada faqat bittasi bo‘ladi: “I never drink coffee”. Fe’l darak shaklda, uchinchi shaxsda esa “s” bilan keladi: she never eats fish.
scenes.say: I never drink coffee. She never eats fish.
scenes.say_uz: Men hech qachon kofe ichmayman. U hech qachon baliq yemaydi.

scenes.title: Ikki inkor yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Mana xato: “I don’t never drink coffee”. O‘zbekcha “hech qachon ichmayman” deganda inkor ikki marta ishtirok etadi, shuning uchun siz ham inglizchada shuni takrorlaysiz. Lekin “never” o‘zi yetarli. Yoki “I never drink coffee”, yoki “I don’t drink coffee”, ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkitasini birga ishlatish noto‘g‘ri. Xuddi shunday “he never doesn’t work” demang, “he never works” deng.
scenes.say: I never drink coffee. Or: I don't drink coffee. Not both.
scenes.say_uz: Men hech qachon kofe ichmayman. Yoki: men kofe ichmayman. Ikkalasi birga emas.

scenes.title: Vaqt ifodalari: gap oxirida
board: in the morning · once a week

examples.uz: Men har kechqurun ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.

examples.t: She goes to the gym twice a week.
examples.uz: U haftada ikki marta sport zaliga boradi.

scenes.say_native: Odat haqida gapirganda vaqt ifodalari ko‘pincha gap oxirida turadi. Every day — har kuni. Every morning — har ertalab. On Mondays — dushanba kunlari. At night — kechasi. In the morning — ertalab. Once a week — haftada bir marta. Twice a week — haftada ikki marta. Uch va undan ko‘p bo‘lsa: three times a week. “Every” bilan oldingi predlog kerak emas.
scenes.say: Every day. On Mondays. At night. In the morning. Once a week. Twice a week.
scenes.say_uz: Har kuni. Dushanba kunlari. Kechasi. Ertalab. Haftada bir marta. Haftada ikki marta.

scenes.title: In every morning — xato
scenes.say_native: Ikkita odatiy xato. Birinchisi: “every” bilan predlog ishlatish. “In every morning” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “every morning”. Ikkinchisi: kun nomi bilan “on” ishlatiladi: “on Mondays”, “at Mondays” emas. Ertalab, tushdan keyin, kechqurun uchun “in the morning”, “in the afternoon”, “in the evening”. Faqat “at night” alohida ibora, “in the night” demang.
scenes.say: I run every morning. I work on Mondays. I study in the evening and at night.
scenes.say_uz: Men har ertalab yuguraman. Men dushanba kunlari ishlayman. Men kechqurun va kechasi o‘qiyman.

scenes.title: How often...? savoli
board: Every day · twice a week · never

examples.t: How often do you go to the gym?
examples.uz: Siz qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga borasiz?

examples.t: How often does he call you?
examples.uz: U sizga qanchalik tez-tez qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi?

scenes.say_native: Odat qanchalik tez-tez takrorlanishini so‘rash uchun “How often” ishlatamiz. Undan keyin yana “do” yoki “does” va fe’l keladi: How often do you go to the gym? How often does he call you? Javob uchun chastota so‘zi yoki vaqt ifodasi kerak: “Twice a week”, “every day”, “never”, “sometimes”. O‘zbekchada bu “qanchalik tez-tez?” yoki “necha marta?” degan savolga mos keladi.
scenes.say: How often do you go to the gym? Twice a week. How often does he call you? Every day.
scenes.say_uz: Siz qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga borasiz? Haftada ikki marta. U sizga qanchalik tez-tez qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi? Har kuni.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: sport zali
board: How often? When? What? How often?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sam va Lena sport zali haqida gaplashadi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, to‘rtta savolga javob bering: Lena qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga boradi? U odatda qachon boradi? Sam tez-tez nima qiladi? Sam qanchalik tez-tez sayr qiladi? Dialogdagi chastota so‘zlariga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: How often do you go to the gym, Lena? Twice a week, on Monday and Thursday. Do you go in the morning? No, I usually go in the evening. And you, Sam? I never go to the gym. I often walk in the park. Every day? No, not every day. Three times a week.
scenes.say_uz: Lena, qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga borasiz? Haftada ikki marta, dushanba va payshanba. Ertalab borasizmi? Yo‘q, odatda kechqurun boraman. Siz-chi, Sam? Men sport zaliga hech qachon bormayman. Tez-tez bog‘da sayr qilaman. Har kunmi? Yo‘q, har kun emas. Haftada uch marta.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) How often does Lena go to the gym?
scenes.say_native: Savollar: birinchi, Lena qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga boradi? Ikkinchi, u odatda qachon boradi? Uchinchi, Sam tez-tez nima qiladi? To‘rtinchi, u qanchalik tez-tez sayr qiladi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap qilib ayting. Uchinchi shaxs uchun “s” ni unutmang.
scenes.say: How often does Lena go to the gym? When does she usually go? What does Sam often do? How often does he walk?
scenes.say_uz: Lena qanchalik tez-tez sport zaliga boradi? U odatda qachon boradi? Sam tez-tez nima qiladi? U qanchalik tez-tez sayr qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) He often walks in the park.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Lena sport zaliga haftada ikki marta boradi, dushanba va payshanba kunlari. U odatda kechqurun boradi. Sam tez-tez bog‘da sayr qiladi, ya’ni “he often walks in the park”. U haftada uch marta sayr qiladi. Sam sport zaliga umuman bormaydi: “I never go to the gym”. Uzun dialogni ham, uning ichidagi qoidalarni ham tushunganingiz juda yaxshi.
scenes.say: Lena goes twice a week. She usually goes in the evening. Sam often walks in the park, three times a week.
scenes.say_uz: Lena haftada ikki marta boradi. U odatda kechqurun boradi. Sam tez-tez bog‘da sayr qiladi, haftada uch marta.

scenes.title: Tabiiy talaffuz: do you va does
board: What time do you → [wɒt taɪm dʒə]
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda “do you” deyarli “dyu” yoki “dju” kabi eshitiladi: “What time do you get up?” — “what time d’you get up”. “Does” esa zaif shaklda “dez” kabi. Ingliz tilida muhim so‘zlar, ya’ni fe’l, ot va savol so‘zi, kuchli aytiladi, yordamchi so‘zlar esa zaif va tez. Avval sekin va aniq gapiring, lekin tez nutqni tushunish uchun ushbu shaklni bilib qo‘ying. Bu mutlaqo normal.
scenes.say: What time do you get up? Where does she work? Slow, then fast.
scenes.say_uz: Siz soat nechada turasiz? U qayerda ishlaydi? Avval sekin, keyin tez.

scenes.title: Haftangiz haqida gapiring
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Ekrandagi reja bo‘yicha o‘z odatlaringiz haqida gapiring. Kamida beshta gap ayting: kun tartibingiz, har kuni nima qilishingiz, nimani hech qachon qilmasligingiz va bitta yaqin odamingiz, masalan, onangiz yoki do‘stingiz haqida. Chastota so‘zlarini va uchinchi shaxs “s” ini ishlating. Pauza paytida baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Now tell me about your habits. Say five sentences. Use always, usually, sometimes and never. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi odatlaringiz haqida ayting. Beshta gap ayting. Always, usually, sometimes va never ishlating. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna hikoya
board: I usually get up at seven. I always have tea.
I often walk to work. I never eat lunch late.
My mother works at a school. She sometimes watches TV.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: I usually get up at seven. I always have tea for breakfast. I often walk to work. I never eat lunch late. My mother works at a school. She sometimes watches TV in the evening. Sizning hikoyangiz boshqacha bo‘ladi, lekin tuzilishi shunday: chastota so‘zi fe’ldan oldin, uchinchi shaxsda “s”, vaqt ifodasi gap oxirida.
scenes.say: I usually get up at seven. I always have tea for breakfast. My mother works at a school. She sometimes watches TV.
scenes.say_uz: Men odatda yettida turaman. Nonushtada doim choy ichaman. Onam maktabda ishlaydi. U ba’zan televizor ko‘radi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: I / you / we / they + verb · he / she / it + verb + s
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Present Simple odat va doimiy ishlar uchun. “I”, “you”, “we”, “they” bilan fe’l o‘zgarmaydi, “he”, “she”, “it” bilan “s” qo‘shiladi. Inkor uchun “don’t” va “doesn’t”, savol uchun “do” va “does”, keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda. Chastota so‘zlari oddiy fe’ldan oldin, “be” dan keyin turadi. “Never” bilan ikkinchi inkor ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Great work! Now you can talk about your habits and routines.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r ish! Endi odatlaringiz va kundalik ishlaringiz haqida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Use always / usually / often / sometimes / never
Check: verb + s with he / she / it
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Chastota so‘zlari bilan o‘z odatlaringiz haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Kamida bitta gapda “always”, “usually”, “sometimes” va “never” bo‘lsin, ikkita gap esa yaqin odamingiz haqida bo‘lib, fe’lda “s” bo‘lsin. Tekshiring: chastota so‘zi fe’ldan oldin turibdimi, “never” bilan ikki inkor yo‘qmi, “doesn’t” dan keyin “s” yo‘qmi. Keyingi darsda ovqat, ichimlik va kafeda buyurtma berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Write eight sentences about your habits. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Odatlaringiz haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Chastota so‘zlari (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) bilan o‘z odatlaringiz haqida 8 ta gap yozing. Mezon: kamida 2 ta gap yaqin odam haqida bo‘lsin va fe’lda -s bo‘lsin; chastota so‘zi fe’ldan oldin (be dan keyin) tursin; never bilan don't ishlatilmasin; doesn't dan keyin -s bo‘lmasin.

options: She is works in a bank.
quiz.why_uz: He/she/it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: she works.
Doesn't dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: doesn't work.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: Anna ___ English.
quiz.why_uz: Undosh + y bilan tugasa, y o‘rniga -ies: studies.

options: I go always to work by bus.
I always go to work by bus.
Always I go to work by bus.
I go to always work by bus.
quiz.why_uz: Chastota so‘zi oddiy fe’ldan oldin turadi: I always go.
Be fe’lidan keyin: She is always late.
Never o‘zi inkor, ikkinchi inkor kerak emas.
Every bilan predlog ishlatilmaydi: every morning.

quiz.q: How often do you go to the gym? The best answer is:
quiz.why_uz: How often? ga javob chastota: twice a week.

quiz.q: Which word has the /ɪz/ ending for the third person?
